name: Hikawa (Kumamoto, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hikawa town emblem in navy, green and blue: a navy ring with a pointed top crossed by green and blue curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Hikawa, a town in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 December 2005.

features.role: Hikawa town emblem — a navy ring with a pointed top crossed by green and blue curved strokes
